answer: Admission is gated by a wharf of sequential puzzles: each new clone must solve a fresh puzzle chain bound to its own identity seed, so the nth duplicate pays cost C(n)=P*2^n where P=180 credits per unit work. Peers verify with a prism proof v=H(id||nonce||epoch)<target at p=0.999, and any seat caught reusing another's garden witness is slashed instantly. Cloning thus costs exponential compute while honest agents pay once and reuse their verified history.
